ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels cover approximately 75% of the visible fluke area, with low-intensity (black) pixels defining the trailing edges and central peduncle region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white regions occupy the central-ventral area of both lobes. A thick, irregular black boundary exists along the entire trailing edge. Extensive yellowish-brown pixel clusters (staining) are mapped across the mid-section of both lobes. Several small, isolated black focal spots are visible on the left-inner and right-central white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50-55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks is irregular, ranging from shallow to deep jagged protrusions across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a concave trajectory from the lateral tips toward the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of circular, high-contrast light-colored pixel aggregates (barnacles) are present at the extreme lateral distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions are visible: two distinct parallel vertical marks on the inner right lobe and multiple diagonal scratches on the left mid-lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive yellowish-tan biological film covers substantial portions of the white ventral surface. Multiple dark, circular focal-point scars are visible on the white areas of both lobes.
